verdict.summary: The new MCP resources and prompts surfaces are coherently wired through the real JSON-RPC dispatch. Resource reads select the default or exact named graph, preserve reserved-URI behavior, distinguish not-found from materialization failure, and use the existing budgeted CONSTRUCT path. Prompt IRI interpolation is guarded by oxrdf NamedNode validation, with hostile and missing arguments rejected before rendering. The end-to-end tests exercise capability advertisement, graph isolation, protocol error codes, real prompt rendering/refusal, and read-only behavior; the public-surface documentation and feature/dependency declarations are updated consistently. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test issue was found in the diff.
